smokeScope: CI SDK/native artifacts from testedCommit (run 35432534541: android-aar and native-android, identical .so sha256 per ABI, and identical again inside the harness APK; arm64-v8a d559ed318ead8fca68fe1da5a3462abdf3dcf21f2523c1e098ca963525633424, armeabi-v7a 8b588b4133d9f96bae42b8cac85050295ed6d72f3e79f10d596666b3d595f9cd) in an isolated Testnet sample with a random seed and no INTERNET permission: create, cold reopen (open() now runs the offline leftover sweep on every open), PublicOffline receive token, stateless token parser, unfunded offline quote rejected, empty send inventory after reopen; no network start or send. The two ABIs used separate runIds (35432534541 and 35432534541-v7a) because the harness namespaces its phase state by runId alone. The harness has no funds, so it does not sign offline: releasing inputs at signing, the Signing leftover sweep, hiding offline rows until their kernel is observed, the one-per-start() kernel round, change recovery, a losing double spend and a reorg are covered off-device by the native host tests (offline_signer_test, offline_history_test, send_admission_test) and the Kotlin JNI fixture tests on the same source. start() itself is not exercised hermetically because it connects to Beam's default peers. The previous main run 35432296215 on 348224d failed only because patch 0016 had lost the CRLF context of base_transaction.cpp; 87f9ef6 restores those bytes and the patched Core sources are identical to the ones the host tests compiled, apart from line endings.
